raw_blocks: SunOpta - Natural Organic Food Products & Ingredient Sourcing Company
Natural Organic Food Products & Ingredient Sourcing Company
SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions and innovation for top brands, retailers and foodservice providers across a broad portfolio of beverages, broths and better-for-you snacks.

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions that fuel and sustain our customers’ success. Today SunOpta produces more than 200 organic certified products and 50 branded non-GMO Project Verified products and ingredients.

We aim to reduce our environmental footprint by finding solutions for more efficient use of electricity, gas and water, achieving zero waste in our manufacturing facilities, developing innovative packaging solutions, optimizing our transportation and responsibly sourcing our ingredients.

We care about the well-being of our employees, people in our supply chains, communities and consumers. We strive to create a safe, healthy, inclusive and engaging work environment that fosters innovation and continuous improvement, while prioritizing food safety and quality.

Our products include plant-based beverages, liquids and dry ingredients (using oat, almond, soy, coconut and other bases) as well as broths, teas and nutritional beverages. We also manufacture better-for-you snacks.
HOW WE GO TO MARKET

With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality, sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice and e-commerce channels across North America.
GROW YOUR CAREER AT SUNOPTA

We care about the well-being of our employees, people in our supply chains and communities. We offer our employees the opportunity to bring well-being to life by providing the world with a broad portfolio of beverages, broths and better-for-you snacks. Our employees are truly empowered to produce the highest-quality products while adhering to industry-leading food safety and manufacturing standards.
